launches.body:
# **📜 Background:**

Co-founder Lukas Bock grew up in a family business with over 100 years in plumbing and electrical trades. He’s seen first-hand how manual quoting in the construction industry is.

Inspired by this legacy, Mercura is now using AI to transform how millions of sales reps at distributors & manufacturers work.

# **❌ Problem:**

When contractors bid on construction projects, they request quotes from distributors and manufacturers, often in unstructured formats like emails, Excel files, and PDFs. These requests contain functional product requirements but frequently lack details.

Distributors and manufacturers employ massive inside sales teams that manually interpret these requests, compare specifications with their product catalog, and select suitable products.

This slow, manual, and error-prone process holds off inside sales teams from their core task—selling—while delaying responses to customers and increasing the risk of lost revenue.

<https://youtu.be/Bn-ENaj_6Tc>

# **🪄 Solution:**

Mercura automates sales quotations for HVAC, electrical and plumbing distributors & manufacturers.

By eliminating repetitive back-office tasks with AI, our software enables sales teams to process RFQs in minutes instead of days. This lets them focus on winning more deals and driving revenue.

Our customers use Mercura to quote significantly more requests automatically, which allows them to maximize their sales potential and win more customers.

This is how it works:

1. **Customer request intake** – Requests arrive in various formats (PDFs, Excel, emails, etc.) and must be processed into the ERP.
2. **Data extraction** – Our AI extracts relevant product information, such as product descriptions, types, manufacturers, part numbers, and quantities, and structures it correctly.
3. **Validation & matching** – Our AI matches line items with the distributor’s product catalog, and suggests the best matches based on the customer’s sales history.
4. **ERP entry** – The quote is automatically entered into the ERP.

# **🌟 About us:**

**Lukas Bock** grew up in a family business with over 100 years in construction. After working as an AI engineer at Google X and Data Scientist at Allianz, he’s now back in the industry to transform how sales reps work.

**Hai Dang** is an AI researcher with experience at Meta and Autodesk, holding patents and over ten first-authored papers at top-tier conferences. He’s an expert in human-AI collaboration and now applying his research to this domain.

**Stefan Zheng** improved operations efficiency across 15+ manufacturing plants as a consultant at Bain. He’s excited to drive sales efficiency in wholesale distribution at scale.

# **🙏 Our Ask:**

1. Intro us to HVAC, electrical and plumbing distributors & manufacturers - we give you 20% of the first monthly fee if we close a deal!
2. We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback at [founders@mercura.ai](mailto:founders@mercura.ai)

Your help can make a huge difference. **Thank you!**

\- Lukas, Stefan & Hai

launches.title: Instinct - Lunar Landers as a Service
launches.tagline: lunar landers designed to launch as a regular LEO rideshares
launches.body:
We are going to the Moon, without spending billions. Launching more often and from any rocket.

### **TL;DR:**

Modern lunar landers are not designed for the realities of today's launch market, leading to infrequent and expensive flights. Instinct is building a lunar lander that can launch from anywhere, increasing flight cadence and decreasing cost.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-WG8NVonbOo>

### **The Problem:**

Demand for the Moon is increasing, and modern landers rely on dedicated launches to the Moon that cost upwards of $100M and only fly once or twice a year. This means payload costs of $1.2M/kg and very limited availability of payload slots. Most potential lunar payloads are either stuck on Earth or never leave the concept stage.

### **Our Solution:**

Instinct's lunar lander is small enough to launch as a rideshare to Low Earth Orbit, enabling low-cost, high-cadence missions. From LEO, our lander makes its way to the Moon without the need for refueling or multiple stages, delivering 20kg of payload to the Moon at a cost per kg of less than half that of current providers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103381&key=user_uploads/1741395/a31b9757-ea96-4f67-8e24-a31ef7bf474b)


At its core, our lunar lander relies on custom propulsion and visual navigation systems, which enable our unique architecture and most importantly are designed to keep vehicle mass as low as possible. This reduces launch cost and maximizes performance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103381&key=user_uploads/1741395/6887996a-f7fc-4d07-a5ae-68e548ba6acf)

### **Who We Are:**

Our team brings years of experience working on space missions including NASA's IMAP, ESA's Solar Orbiter, and PhiSat-2.

We are super passionate about space exploration, and have also experienced firsthand the pains involved in developing lunar missions nowadays. We think getting to the Moon should be routine.

### **What's Next:**

* Integrated tests of our reaction control thrusters
* Flight of our hopper test vehicle
* A lot of testing
* First lunar mission in Q4 2028

### **Asks:**

* Fly a payload to the Moon\![ https://www.instinct-space.com/fly-with-us](https://www.instinct-space.com/fly-with-us)
* Commercial/Government Intros
* Join the team[ https://www.instinct-space.com/careers](https://www.instinct-space.com/careers)

**At SAMMY, we do knowledge.** Not “find me every time _\[thing\]_ was mentioned,” but real knowledge.

A compliance or legal update comes in — where does it apply, how does it affect our processes, and what should we do next?

A process changes — which related processes need updating? Update them for me.

In his time leading teams at Palantir, our CEO, Joe, saw how painful it was for his customers to adapt to a process change. It wasn’t that the change itself was difficult, it was the cascading effects - 10s, sometimes 100s, of other processes also needed updating; people weren’t informed; automations couldn’t handle it. AI only makes the problem worse, without a source of truth AI is just a parrot of misinformation. This is particularly apparent when compliance changes come into effect where the cost is, well, costly. \

# Unreliable RAG or code generation? We can help.

Reasoning models have been all the rage lately because they beat generic benchmarks. The problem is that your business isn’t a generic benchmark - it’s a set of specific vertical tasks like codegen, compliance, legal or healthcare. Massive companies like Google and OpenAI have internal tools to train their models, but those aren’t available to the people that need it: the developers deploying these models into production.

We’ve personally been involved on both sides: Jackson optimized the Gemini models at Google and Mason hit the limits of off shelf models while leading engineering at Second (YC W23).

So we created **TrainLoop**, packaging the same RL techniques big AI labs use into an accessible platform. Our process is three simple steps:

1. **Data Curation:** Our lightweight SDK (just three lines of code) gathers training signals from actual usage.
2. **Training:** We build a reward model that teaches your LLM what output you prefer.
3. **Inference:** Deploy automatically and call your model via standard APIs.

<https://youtu.be/XhbxHOzsxRE>

# Ready to Level Up Your Model?

It’s time to move past “prompt-hell” and unreliable outputs. [**Join our alpha**](https://app.trainloop.ai/waitlist) to make your language model an expert in your business and unlock production-ready performance.

Hey! We’re Kevin and Regina from [Dexterity](https://getdexterity.com/). Today, we’re launching Dex—the fastest interface for co-working with AI, right inside your browser.

**TLDR:** **AI that works _with you,_ not just for you**. 10x your workflows without breaking your flow. Try [**Dex**](https://youtu.be/H6hMAVkGp8M) (Beta) → [**getdexterity.com**](http://getdexterity.com)

### **Why We’re Building This**

**Four weeks before Demo Day, we pivoted to build for ourselves.**

Most AI web agents today are “set-and-forget” chats—you hand them off and check back later. But what about workflows you actually _want_ to drive? Navigating platforms, moving data, making quick decisions—these moments demand instant, context-aware models that work with you, not just for you.

Imagine using Operator to order DoorDash—a frustratingly back-and-forth relay with no real-time visibility. That same friction exists for work tools like Jira, GSuite, and GitHub, where users need instant feedback and responsive action, not slow AI handoffs.

**That’s why we’re taking a Cursor (vs. Devin) approach—for the browser.**

### **The Problem**

Modern work is a juggling act of 15+ tabs, software bloat, and constant UI friction, just to complete a single task.

The real bottleneck isn’t just automation—it’s context switching. Traditional solutions force users to memorize shortcuts (appeals to devs, but leaves everyone else behind), while AI tools make you adapt to them instead of living right where you work.

**Why not turn your browser itself into an intelligent personal workspace?**

### **How It Works**

With simple voice and text, Dex enhances familiar interfaces, automates mundane actions, and understands your intent.

* **Smart Navigation**🔸Find, execute, and move between apps.
* **Suggest Context**🔸Cut down tab-switching and manual searching.
* **Cross-App Automation**🔸Shortcut multi-step workflows, zero setup.
* **Adaptive UI/UX**🔸Reshape, replicate, and browse by your rules.

Think of it like Spotlight Search meets AI automation + personal expert for everyday apps.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87902&key=user_uploads/1003357/5841f4c8-281d-4bdd-a4b0-053d44c7b41d)

### **Use Cases**

* **GSuite** – Write emails, find docs, and move data anywhere.
* **GitHub** – Search repos, manage issues, and navigate faster.

### **Coming Soon…**

* **Meetings** 📅 → Create and join calendar and Zoom events instantly

* **Snippets** ✂️ → Dex captures notes, links, and frequent snippets

### **Our Ask**

We’re building Dex for power users, founders, students, and curious explorers—because that’s who we are.

launches.body:
Hi, we’re Samai and Nand — Co-Founders of Axal 👋

If you're selling to a sticky product to enterprises, you've probably run into this:

“We’d love to use your product, but our stack is too old...”

That’s where we come in.

Axal reverse engineers legacy codebases (Java, C#) to generate **functional requirements and user stories in hours** — essentially helping your clients expedite the discovery process of their modernization. launches.title: Axal - Automate identifying and fixing architectural tech debt
launches.tagline: Break down monoliths, identify tech debt, and fix it with AI at scale!
launches.body:
Hey everyone, I’m Nand - Founder at Axal👋\
\
We built a tool that uses deterministic methods to **automate the hardest parts of application modernization**— identifying architectural bottlenecks and prioritizing those issues based on business value. Once the issues are broken down by Axal, AI can autonomously collaborate with your team to resolve them.

# **The Problem**

Everyone knows that software teams cut corners in development over time, resulting in accumulation of debt tech overtime that slows them down and raises costs. Until now, to address this problem there needed to be long modernization efforts, where stakeholders spent months finding possible solutions to the problem, if you could even find and train the team members needed to do the work. 

# **Our Solution: One platform for Application Modernization**

Axal uses deterministic methods to provide teams with clear observability into architectural technical debt.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/5453ac1a-0928-4ba2-91f1-665ad2c142fd)

We show tech debt scores tailored to your goals. For example, if maintainability is your focus, we display the maintainability index, aligning business impact with priorities to guide effective action.

Technical teams can leverage our graphs to gain clear insights into class-level and domain-level codebase relationships.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/ceaeb77c-b33c-4ef2-8540-3e5fc5f564d2)

Architectural issues - domain exclusivity, circular dependencies, dead code, etc. - are automatically detected based on the goals that an organization makes, and engineers can work with Axal to assign their priority.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/f63d172c-c479-4a22-92b6-ab40ffdd2ef7)

Once prioritized, **Axal leverages AI to autonomously address issues**, while ensuring none of the existing code breaks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86865&key=user_uploads/570999/01d79606-ac19-4fd4-a503-aff34a23a9c8)

**Demo Video** (\* excludes technical debt scores and AI code fix demonstration)

<https://youtu.be/4WAwWXrpAGU>

\- If you want to see your team's architectural technical debt

launches.tagline: The UX of ChatGPT in your own app, connected to your own AI agents.
launches.body:
Hi YC! I’m Simon, building **assistant-ui**, an open source Typescript/React library for AI chat.

Hundreds of projects use assistant-ui to build in-app AI assistants, including companies like:

![Logos of LangChain, AthenaIntelligence, Browser Use, Stack AI](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d3eda556-de8c-4404-b4be-c0295f9aeb8e)

With >50k+ monthly downloads, assistant-ui is the most popular UI library for AI chat.

## **Getting Started**

You can get started by running **\`npx assistant-ui create\`** (new project) or **\`npx assistant-ui init\`** (existing project) in your terminal.

![Gif showing the setup process, which takes under 30 seconds](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/17c78ae1-d8cf-4fc4-a8aa-056fe449da02)

## **Features**

* **Pre-built components**, fully customizable
* **Connects to your backend**
  * We have first class integration for **AI SDK** and **LangGraph** or build your own
* **Generative UI**: Map LLM tool calls and JSONs to custom UI components
* **Frontend Tool Calls:** Let LLMs take action in your frontend app
* **Human Tool Calls:** Human approvals and input collection
* **Chat history and analytics** via assistant-cloud (the hosted offering)

## **Customization**

The API of assistant-ui is inspired by libraries like **Radix UI** and **cmdk**. Instead of a single monolithic chat component, we give you composable primitives and a great starter configuration. You have full control over the look and feel of every pixel while leaving auto-scrolling, LLM streaming and accessibility to us.

![Photo showing the modular component structure. ComposerPrimitive.Input is the chat input field, ComposerPrimitive.Send is the send button.](/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d8eacc69-2d94-4c43-8fab-2dcac5e7f029)

Sample customization to make a perplexity lookalike:

![Perplexity lookalike Chat UI](/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/16e96ae2-d563-4f6c-9047-6c3485a1cb3d)

## **Demo Video**

[Demo Video](https://youtu.be/9eLKs9AM4tU?si=jm9GzoFAcyM_tPT-)

## **About**

I’ve wanted to build my own dev tool company since high school. Last year, I built the first version of assistant-ui because I needed the UX of ChatGPT in my own app. The app I was building didn’t work out, but few friends asked me about the chat UI. Since then, AI chat has became increasingly popular as a means for delegating tasks to AI agents. My focus is on enabling human <> agent collaboration through better UX and AX (agent experience).

![Photo of Simon, the founder](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d43c8332-b160-40d8-8f27-849bd82806e3)

* [Star us on GitHub](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui)
* [Join our Discord](https://discord.com/invite/S9dwgCNEFs)
* [Book a sales call](https://cal.com/simon-farshid/assistant-ui)

launches.body:
Reliable financial data access and trust in outputs are still the bottleneck in adopting AI in banking, consulting and investment firms. We built Fira MCP to solve that, starting from for teams adopting Claude. Our data connector lets your AI read and cite SEC and international filings, UK Companies House, market data, and earnings transcripts. It works with Claude, Claude for Excel, ChatGPT, and Copilot, while setup takes 3 minutes and it's free to try - <https://firaresearch.com/mcp>.

<https://youtu.be/JoEY1imdVhw>

### Problem

Many banking, consulting, and investment firms are moving day-to-day AI work to Claude. But reliable data access and trust in the outputs are still the bottleneck.

### Solution - Fira MCP

Fira MCP plugs directly into Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and Claude for Excel as a data connector. Your AI gets access to filings, transcripts, and market data, with numbers linked back to the exact paragraph or row in the source document. It handles scanned PDFs, nested tables, and works across tens of documents in a single research thread.

## Available datasets

* **SEC Filings** — 8,000+ active US companies (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and more)
* **UK Companies House** — 5M+ private companies, including scanned accounts
* **International filings** — 10,000+ companies across 50+ countries
* **Earnings call transcripts** — full transcripts with analyst Q&A
* **Market data** — 20+ years of daily stock and FX, US and global
* **Custom datasets** — proprietary and third-party integrations for enterprise

### Use cases

**I. Peer comparison in Excel** — pull financials, strategy, and risk factors across competitors directly from filings.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100809&key=user_uploads/626328/99b5fdce-2a4b-4053-a6c1-6b94ec87d578)

launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Commercial insurance brokers spend 80% of their time on manual, repetitive tasks like policy analysis, manual data entry, documentation, billing and administration. Vantel builds AI software that automates these workflows, **currently helping brokers save 10+ hours per week**. Our first product lets brokers compare five 100-page insurance policies across 50 factors in 5 minutes instead of 5 hours.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ybGwHNyi90>

**The Problem: Commercial Insurance is Extremely Manual**

Almost every company needs insurance. Most companies do not have the competency in-house to know exactly what coverage they need. Because of this, they often hire a commercial insurance broker to advise them on insurance-related matters.

After interviewing 100 commercial insurance professionals, we discovered some of the largest challenges in the industry: documents and workflows are unstandardized, there are multiple parties involved, and high-quality data is hard to collect. This results in **commercial insurance brokers spending the majority of their time on highly manual processes**:

* Comparing policy documents
* Validating insurance requirements in contracts versus policies
* Regulatory documentation of advisory work
* Compiling claims data from multiple sources into a common format
* Translating complex material from carriers to a digestible format for the client

**Our Solution: AI-Powered Workflow Automation for Brokers**

Vantel is building an AI platform that automates the most time-consuming tasks for commercial insurance brokers. We have started with:

**1. Policy Comparison**

* Compare 5 policies in 5 minutes (versus 5 hours if done manually)
* Works with any carrier and policy type, instantly recognizing differences and key terms
* Ranks policies based on coverage quality

**2. Contract Validation**

* Cross-check insurance requirements in contracts versus policies
* Identifies gaps in current coverage, to avoid hidden risks
* Enables more extensive client service – this is currently a high-touch activity

**Why Now?**

With recent advances in LLMs, we are creating a product that was impossible to build 12 months ago. During our conversations with brokers, we have learned that **it is absolutely possible to build a revolutionary product in commercial insurance in just a few months**. The feedback we’re getting from brokers is giving us an incredible conviction that we’re on the right track. It is amazing to see their jaws drop when they realize countless hours of work can be automated with our software, freeing up time to serve more clients.

launches.title: BlindPay - Stablecoin API for Global Payments
launches.tagline: Core Infrastructure for LatAm Payments
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

BlindPay is a stablecoin API that helps companies navigate LatAm's complex financial regulations while enabling fast and affordable global payments. Watch our demo [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N9hHISlGp9Y).

### **The Problem**

Businesses face significant hurdles when sending and receiving global payments:

* Traditional methods rely on correspondent banks, adding fees (1.5-6% for B2B) and delays of 2-5 business days or more. Bank transfers typically require 2-4 intermediaries between smaller countries, with costs reaching hundreds of dollars. 
* Frequent fluctuations in Latin American currencies, coupled with extreme inflation rates (over 50% annually in some countries), make international payments unpredictable and risky. 
* Complex regulations and strict compliance rules across jurisdictions require different documentation for each institution. 
* Fragmented payment landscapes across countries require integration with multiple local payment systems (like SPEI, Pix, PSE), making implementation resource-intensive

### **Our Solution**

Our API integrates seamlessly with your existing workflows. With BlindPay you can:

* Send and receive payments using fiat money and stablecoins
* Get competitive FX quotes and low transaction fees
* Connect directly to local instant payment systems across Latin America
* 24/7 payments with instant settlement
* Ensure compliance through blockchain screening, tiered KYC/KYB levels, and continuous transaction monitoring

Expand your global reach while reducing costs and transaction times by up to 80%. Powered by stablecoins and blockchain, our platform eliminates the delays, high fees, and regulatory barriers of traditional payment systems.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87070&key=user_uploads/2098545/f81c874e-a8e7-4a92-ab1e-de8897529a63)

### **Developer Experience**

Add fiat gateways to your apps with minimal code. Our SDKs support multiple languages and frameworks, backed by a developer-friendly REST API with public OpenAPI documentation.

* Support for multiple blockchains and major stablecoins
* Direct integration with local payment systems like SPEI (Mexico), Pix (Brazil), PSE (Colombia) and Transfers (Argentina)
* Separate sandbox and production environments with unique API keys and webhooks
* Real-time payment tracking and transaction monitoring

### **Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87070&key=user_uploads/2098545/d3fdd3f4-c653-427c-8e06-159b1ac4809f)

**Bernardo Simonassi (CEO)** has been shaping the stablecoin payments industry for the past 3 years, where he developed the first payroll platform powered by stablecoins. Previously at PicPay, he developed instant payment solutions serving 60M+ users.

**Gabriel Lyra (CTO)** led software engineering at LendingClub, where he architected and implemented critical financial infrastructure handling $50B in monthly loan transactions. Previously at AWS, he optimized infrastructure scripts that reduced monthly costs from $15M to $1M.

**João Borges (COO)** is a prominent leader and entrepreneur, best known for founding one of Brazil's largest blockchain startups. In its first year of operation, he successfully scaled the company to seven-digit revenue and raised millions of dollars from top-tier venture capitalists. João is also an active contributor to the Nouns DAO ecosystem and has been recognized on the Forbes 30 Under 30 list.

**Gustavo Marinho (CPO)** is a former product leader at top-tier Brazilian fintechs, where he specialized in consumer-facing financial solutions for Latin America. Previously at PicPay, he built instant payment solutions and credit products, successfully growing a personal loan portfolio to over $100M within six months of launch. 

### **Our Ask**

Hey founders, are you building a product that needs global payment functionality? Email us at [founders@blindpay.com](mailto:founders@blindpay.com)

BlindPay is the simplest way to integrate global payments into your product:

* Neobanks & fintech
* Payroll solutions
* Remittance providers
* Wallet infrastructure providers
* Traditional FX industry
* Stablecoin aggregators
* Marketplaces & platforms

name: Red Barn Robotics
long_description: We are building an autonomous robot to precisely eliminate weeds and leave crops untouched. Despite $100 billion being spent annually on weed control, weeds still cost the US economy $46B/year. Weeds steal sunlight and nutrients from crops, forcing farmers to choose between higher costs and lower yields. Moreover, many farms still rely on hand labor to control weed growth. The process is slow, expensive, and increasingly difficult due to constant labor shortages (1 out of every 5 US farm positions go unfilled each year). Our robot nicknamed the Field Hand is able to automate one of the worst jobs on a farm and will help healthily feed the world.
one_liner: A Roomba for weeds on a farm.
